At 300 L/(s·ha) spacing must shrink to ≈56 m. Max manhole spacing equals sewer; look up GB 50282 by diameter.
map.雨水井距为什么和污水一样？: Why is storm manhole spacing the same as sewer?
map.检查井最大间距主要受疏通与检修要求控制，与输送介质关系不大，因此《室外排水设计规: Max manhole spacing is driven mainly by cleaning and inspection needs and barely depends on the medium, so the Outdoor Drainage Design Code uses the same diameter bands for storm and sewer pipes.
map.收水口间距为什么和检查井不一致？: Why does inlet spacing differ from manhole spacing?
map.检查井间距由检修要求决定，收水口间距由汇水与泄水能力决定，两者控制条件不同。实际: Manhole spacing is set by inspection needs, inlet spacing by catchment/drainage capacity; the two have different constraints. Use the smaller of the two in practice and densify at low points and intersections.
